name: @vrmxg/director
description: VRMXG's LLM director (M3 W0): persona-driven decisions made outside the 60 Hz step. A LanguageModel adapter (shell bridge, loopback HTTP, scripted, replay), one shared request queue, prompts in VRMXA §11 order, tool schemas narrowed per character and moment from @vrmxg/ai's action vocabulary, validation against the schema and the world, and decisions that enter the step only through ai.inject, logged so a conversation replays without the model.
